name: Birdie Wadsworth
role: Young woman named in the Medora local news
bio: Miss Birdie Wadsworth went to Bismarck to attend school in September 1885. In 1886 she visited friends in Steele and was sick for several days in December.
mentions: Miss Birdie Wadsworth started for Bismarck this morning, where she will attend school this winter.
Miss Birdie Wadsworth went to Steele, Dak., last week. She will visit friends there.
Miss Birdie Wadsworth has been quite sick for several days.
